sections.heading: Wasalt - Saudi Arabia’s trusted real estate platform
sections.text: Saudi Arabia's AI-backed real estate platform for verified properties and trusted brokers. Wasalt is a Saudi-based real estate platform that makes it easier to discover properties, explore opportunities, and connect with property experts across the Kingdom. Whether you’re looking to buy, rent, sell, or invest, Wasalt brings the right properties, insights, and services together in one place.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.text: Commonly asked questions about Wasalt and the services we provide Wasalt is a leading platform in Saudi Arabia for electronic real estate services, licensed by the Real Estate General Authority (REGA). To list your property on Wasalt, start by creating an account, then entering property details, uploading photos, and setting prices, primarily through the Wasalt App, Wasalt Business App, or website. Click the profile icon (top left on the web or via the burger menu in the app). Enter your mobile number and complete OTP verification. Wasalt Auctions is a feature where real estate assets are sold through timed auctions. Bidders can compete to determine the final sale price. Auctions include assets from private sellers and those in collaboration with Infath (Entrustment and Liquidation Center). Matchmaker helps you find potential leads based on your live listings. It matches leads based on the property type, purpose, district, and category of your live property. Once your listing is live, Matchmaker will show leads that match those preferences, making it easier for you to connect with the right leads. Wasalt is an AI-powered real estate portal for verified properties, projects, masterplans, online auctions, and daily rentals. Providing an enhanced search experience for users pursuing their ideal homes.
